title: Garish, shiny, orangey gold
text: Garish, shiny, orangey gold. This was not my taste, and Kate Spade designs usually are. This thing is so shiny and brassie and cheap-looking that it would fit in on the set of The Sopranos. The gift box it comes in, however, is gorgeous.

product_metadata.title: Kate Spade Gold Crown Point 4" X 6" Frame, 1.25 LB
description: Place your photos in an elegant gold-plated kate spade new york Crown Point 4" x 6" Picture Frame by Lenox. Crafted by Lenox of gold-plated metal under license by kate spade new york, which has reviewed this product for quality and authenticity. Holds a 4" x 6" photo or document. Height: 8.25" Packaged in a kate spade new york box.
